descriptions.shortDescription: Software catalog and IT asset registry for Nextcloud.
descriptions.longDescription: Software Catalogs provides a centralised registry for managing software assets, applications, and IT components within Nextcloud. It enables organisations to catalogue their software landscape, track licenses, and maintain an overview of deployed applications. Built on Open Register, it integrates with Nextcloud's collaboration ecosystem and supports Dutch government software inventory requirements.

Software Catalogs biedt een gecentraliseerd register voor het beheren van softwareactiva, applicaties en IT-componenten binnen Nextcloud. Het stelt organisaties in staat hun softwarelandschap te catalogiseren, licenties bij te houden en een overzicht te bewaren van geïmplementeerde applicaties. Gebouwd op Open Register integreert het met het Nextcloud-ecosysteem en ondersteunt de vereisten voor softwareinventarisatie van de Nederlandse overheid.

metrics.name: Contributor Absence Factor
metrics.explanation: The fewest people who together made half of the commits on the default branch in the last 12 months, of the 100 contributors GitHub reports, among 8 human contributors. At 1 the project depends on a single person. Bots are left out; one person with several accounts or addresses counts more than once.

metrics.name: Organizational Diversity
metrics.explanation: Organisations are told apart by the email domain of the latest 300 commits of the last 12 months (191 commits by people, after the .mailmap) and, for a personal or hidden address, by the company on the author's public profile. The largest is conduction.nl (4 authors), with 100% of the 191 commits whose organisation is known; 0% of the commits come from 0 of 4 authors whose organisation stays unknown. Only these counts are kept, no names, addresses or companies; an organisation is named only when several authors share it.

metrics.name: Change Request Closure Ratio
metrics.explanation: 1,232 change requests were closed (merged or not) and 1,300 opened in the last 90 days, bots included. Below 1 the open backlog grows; above 1 it shrinks.

metrics.name: Time to First Response
metrics.explanation: None of the 15 latest change requests opened by people between 2026-08-21 and 2026-11-12 got a comment or review from anyone but its author.

metrics.name: Issue Response Time

metrics.name: Release Frequency
metrics.explanation: 29 final releases were published in the last 12 months, about one every 13 days, counted from the GitHub releases. The latest final release is from 2026-09-06. Besides these, 488 pre-releases were published; they are not counted. Drafts and pre-releases are left out.
